text: I bring this motion to the Committee as a matter of urgency as third party construction takes place along Keele Street north and south of Sheppard Avenue. My office has fielded a wide range of calls questioning unjustified lane closures, traffic and project management and project purpose. The project is managed by nearby property owner Canada Lands Corporation and its construction partners. The construction is related to sanitary sewer work and other infrastructure that will connect to the Black Creek Tunnel Project, slated to commence in 2027. There is no indication that a construction notice was sent to residents for this project. Road Occupancy Permits have been issued by the City of Toronto for work South of Sheppard Avenue West, near Wycombe Road (Tor-RD1S2026) and near Maryport Avenue (Tor-RD1S2026-677).
